review: Independent mobile visible-play review of SOULFALL Build76

method.input: Authorized mobile-playtest helper, native Chromium CDP touch only, maximum two contacts; no keyboard or mouse.
method.inspection: Screenshots inspected before adaptive inputs. Visible handbook, HUD, map and terminal UI only; no source, tests, docs, earlier reviews, hidden state, game handles, test URL or arbitrary evaluation.
method.conditions: Synthetic paused phone emulation. Each live action captured the scene and paused; the map also paused play. Software-WebGL fallback enabled; renderer not certified. Screenshot scale 3.

scale.overall_rule: Equal-weight mean of the five category scores; subjective assessment of this observed run, not a completion or performance certification.

controls.reason: Movement, scene drag, fire drag, reload, dash, hold-use and vault responded. Precise positioning was difficult: short strafes overshot Mara, multiple recovery holds failed outside reach, and aim corrections consumed substantial ammunition. The run ended at 10% accuracy. These are observed difficulties for this reviewer under stepped emulation, not proof of an input defect.

gameplay.reason: A complete loss was reachable through meaningful combat, navigation, recovery and boss decisions. All three recoveries succeeded; shield regeneration and recovery-related health increases enabled survival at low health. Custodian armor/exposure and a close-dash phase break provided visible tactical feedback. Enemy pressure punished stationary aiming and navigation detours. Extraction was not reached.

presentation.reason: Cohesive rainy industrial setting, cyan/amber visual language, clear receiver signage, animated weapon/reload and a composed terminal screen. Scene geometry and dark silhouettes could obscure enemies and firing faces; software rendering prevents performance conclusions.

usability.reason: Map paused planning and showed recovered objectives; reach messages gave actionable distances; objective transitions and terminal statistics were explicit. The route to the Heart still involved cover collisions, a failed direct north approach and a wall detour. Many right-side buttons competed with scene visibility and attention. The handbook required a native swipe to read later steps.

readability.reason: Main objective, health, ammo and terminal headline were readable. Map labels, coil percentages, helper text and terminal accuracy/details were small at 844x390 CSS. The two-line right-thumb FIRE drag-aim label and dense notification banners added visual load; enlarged screenshot viewing may make fine text easier than on a physical phone.

outcome.custodian: Broadcast coil disabled; visible status 3 OFF, 1 100%, 2 100% at 01:42. Loss followed during the next firing attempt.
outcome.time_note: Terminal displays cumulative play time. This was exactly one fresh attempt with zero uplink retries; wall-clock review time includes pauses and is not the mission timer.

observations.fact: Handbook initially showed only the first steps; a native swipe exposed coil and upload instructions.
Opening guard disappeared after a 17-round forward burst; terminal later reported two total eliminations.
observations.inference: The opening burst killed the guard; no per-enemy kill counter was visible.

observations.fact: Initial westward route met low cover. A left strafe plus jump and forward movement reached Mara.
Mara hold attempts failed at 1.4m and 1.0m outside reach. A forward-left adjustment followed by a stationary hold recovered her at 00:38.
Several aim corrections missed while shield and then health fell. At 00:49 health was 27 and a perimeter-discharge warning was visible.

A vault prompt changed to ordinary JUMP after use, but further forward travel faced a wall. Eastward movement also reached a wall; turning south opened the route. Health reached 2, then shield regenerated while repositioning.

A hold from the first Heart approach did not recover Sera; button still read 2.0m CLOSER. A short advance, burst and stationary hold recovered Sera at 01:20. Health visibly rose from 2 to 22 across this recovery.
Eastward dash/run took damage; direction changed toward the archive after a visible interceptor instruction. At 0.5m outside reach, a short backward adjustment and hold recovered Elian at 01:29.

First Custodian volley hit no registered coil damage with a pillar obstructing the view. A strafe cleared more of the face. A close dash then announced a phase break, but movement passed the firing face. Turning back and correcting aim disabled coil 3.
The next aim/reload/wait/fire sequence ended at the actual loss UI. No retry or new attempt followed.

concrete_issues.issue: Fine receiver positioning was difficult under these touch inputs.
concrete_issues.impact: Multiple failed holds and exposure to enemy fire.
concrete_issues.suggestion: Consider a gentler low-deflection movement range or clearer receiver approach guidance.
concrete_issues.confidence: Observed friction; cause may include stepped-input technique.

concrete_issues.issue: Route guidance pointed toward destinations through cover and wall geometry from several positions.
concrete_issues.impact: Direct movement led to collisions, overshoots and damaging detours.
concrete_issues.suggestion: Make the next navigable opening more visually distinct from the destination marker.
concrete_issues.confidence: Observed route confusion; no claim that pathfinding was broken.

concrete_issues.issue: Small labels and percentages at this landscape size.
concrete_issues.impact: Map and boss-state details required close inspection.
concrete_issues.suggestion: Increase mobile map label and coil-status text size.

concrete_issues.issue: Dense controls and notification banners occupy substantial combat space.
concrete_issues.impact: Reduced unobstructed view and competing visual demands during aim and movement.
concrete_issues.suggestion: Consider a compact mobile control layout and stronger prioritization of urgent messages.
concrete_issues.confidence: Direct visual observation; physical thumb occlusion was not tested.

coverage.uncertainty: One subjective attempt; low accuracy and navigation trouble reflect this reviewer in paused software emulation. No inference of full game completion, physical performance, or broader reliability from partial phase coverage.

cleanup.verified: Exact owned driver and Chrome PIDs absent after driver exit. No unrelated processes or servers killed.
